entries.text: Idea: adding a secondary cooling vent that looks like the ones on a Viper, just for style points.

searching the wires for the perfect pressure relief valve specs

entries.text: Wrote in his diary: "the pressure is on"
Wrote a letter to his creator: "still searching"

aiming my brass dish at the deep black, pinging the void
entries.why: i'm tired of the silence and need to know someone else is scanning the frequencies.
